Side finding for the owner (no op): the usual Foggy Dew line to Cooney Lake turns right onto Martin Creek #429 at the ~5-mi junction; Cooney Lake Trail #434 is only the last 0.2 mi at the lake (or the high route over the pass from Merchants Basin). The row's day-1 note and its waypoint 2 ('Merchants Basin / Cooney Lake Trail #434 split', 7,300 ft, distMi 5.5) mix the two, and 6.2 matches neither (it matches Martin Creek #429's own one-way length, as noted in r25).
